title: A Fateful Decision
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's consciousness fell completely into darkness, the fourth page of the Tianji Record burst forth with dazzling golden light—a silhouette of the complete Tianji Record slowly emerging in the void, while that indifferent eye watching everything awaited the final move of the chess game.

text.content: The runes on the altar blazed to their extreme, the blood-colored light piercing the sky nearly tearing apart the entire night. Chen Ji stood at the crossroads, watching the slender figure at the altar's center gradually becoming translucent—that was Chen Nian, his sister he had searched for seven full years.

Her lips were moving, and though the distance was too great to hear any sound, Chen Ji read the lip shape clearly—Don't. He let out a bitter laugh in his heart. You silly girl, how could your brother not want you after searching for so long?

dialogue.content: Chen Nian... watch my lips, listen carefully—

text.content: Chen Ji's voice was so faint amidst the cacophony of the ritual, yet miraculously, Chen Nian on the altar heard him. Her eyes widened sharply, tears brimming, and her trembling lips responded—Don't! Don't do this!

The Tianji Record trembled violently within his mind, the seal on the fourth page loosening to its absolute limit. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested in the void, his form more translucent than ever before, his aged face a canvas of complex emotions.

dialogue.content: Are you certain? The price this time will be far heavier than you can imagine. Severing the connection to the Heavenly Fate Lock requires the Chen family mark flowing through your bloodline.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's words struck like thunder, and Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record quaking wildly within his mind. This was the most profound moment of choice since obtaining the Tianji Record.

choices.text: Severe the connection using bloodline as the price
choices.description: Burn your own Chen family bloodline to completely sever the ritual's connection with Chen Nian. The price: you will never again be a member of the Chen family.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the Chen family bloodline mark
choices.risk_hint: Forever lose the bond with your family

dialogue.content: I am a Chen person, my blood carries the Chen family's mark. Then let it go—burn!

choices.description: Attempt to use the Tianji Record to find a method that doesn't require bloodline sacrifice, but time may run out.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate will be severely depleted

text.content: The Tianji Record flipped rapidly, countless images flashing before Chen Ji's eyes—yet every single one pointed to the same conclusion: there was no other way. Time was slipping away rapidly.

The seal on the fourth page of the Tianji Record shattered with a deafening crash, countless golden runes gushing forth like a torrent, forming a resplendent cocoon of light around Chen Ji. Those were the chains of fate, the prophetic shackles the Chen family had borne for generations—and now, they were breaking.

dialogue.content: From this day forward, you are no longer my sister; you are merely a free woman—Chen Nian.

text.content: The moment the words fell, the altar erupted with a thunderous roar. Those blood-red threads wrapped around Chen Nian began to unravel one by one, dissolving into scattered motes of light that vanished into the night sky. And Chen Ji's body began a terrifying transformation at this very moment.

choice.prompt: The bloodline was burning, Chen Ji's body growing translucent, yet he showed no signs of retreat.

choices.description: Burn the last trace of bloodline power, ensuring the ritual collapses utterly with no possibility of revival.
choices.visible_reward: The ritual can never be restarted

dialogue.content: Since we're doing this, let's do it thoroughly—burn all my bloodline!

text.content: The fourth page of the Tianji Record gradually unfurled, countless ancient characters flowing forth like water. Chen Ji saw a truth buried for ten thousand years—the Chen family bloodline was from an ancient prophetic clan, guardians of the Tianji Record's complete inheritance through generations. And the Eye of Heavenly Dao wished to seize the Chen family's heavenly fate power through Chen Nian, this 'Heavenly Fate Lock', to reshape the order of heaven.

The complete content of the fourth page exploded like thunder in the depths of the Tianji Record. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's scheme was far more profound than imagined—it had treated all past prophets as chess pieces, and the Tianji Record was merely one of its pieces placed in the mortal realm. Ten thousand years of scheming, all for this very moment.

Chen Nian's body shuddered violently, those blood-red threads dissolving completely. Her feet finally touched the altar's stone floor, her translucent skin regaining flesh's color. She gazed at her own hands in bewilderment, then abruptly raised her head—her brother stood nearby, but his body had already begun to dissipate.

dialogue.content: Brother! What have you done! Your body... your body is vanishing!
Silly girl... I told you, I would come for you. Your brother just... did what should have been done long ago.

text.content: Chen Ji felt his body becoming translucent piece by piece, bloodline burning, flesh dissolving, every bone producing cracking sounds. But there was no pain on his face, only an unprecedented tranquility. The Chen family bloodline had bound him for twenty years, and now, he could finally protect the person he wished to protect in his own way.

dialogue.content: No! I don't want you to save me! Why would you do this! You are my brother!

text.content: Chen Ji used his last strength to raise his hand, gently touching Chen Nian's cheek. That hand had become translucent, the starry sky faintly visible behind it, yet he still tenderly wiped away the tears on her face.

dialogue.content: Silly girl... being your brother is the greatest fortune of my life. Even without the Chen family bloodline, I will always be your brother. This... will never change.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji's consciousness was about to dissipate completely, the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light. The seal on the fourth page shattered utterly, a complete rune formation taking shape around Chen Ji—the silhouette of the complete Tianji Record slowly emerging from the void.

Chen Nian embraced Chen Ji's gradually translucent body in terror, tears streaming endlessly. She could feel her brother's life force rapidly draining away, like fine sand held in the palm, impossible to retain no matter what. The runes on the altar had completely dimmed, yet her heart was more terrified than ever before.

dialogue.content: Brother! Don't leave me! I just found you! Please, don't...

text.content: Chen Ji's consciousness drifted in darkness, Chen Nian's wails his only concern. He wished to respond, to tell her not to cry, to say he was overjoyed to see her again—but his lips could no longer move. Before the last thread of consciousness dissolved, he saw his sister's tear-streaked face—the most beautiful scenery he had ever witnessed in his life.

The altar collapsed, dust filling the heavens. Chen Nian knelt in the ruins, clutching the unconscious Chen Ji in her arms, tears dripping onto his face drop by drop. The Tianji Record floated above the two, golden light blazing, the fourth page's complete content gradually revealing itself. And behind that radiance, an immense entity composed of countless eyes slowly opened—THE EYE OF HEAVENLY DAO, finally revealing itself.

The cold gaze penetrated the void, as if the entire world held its breath at this moment. Before Chen Ji's consciousness completely dissolved into darkness, he heard Chen Nian's heart-wrenching cry—'Brother!' That wail pierced infinite darkness like a blade, brutally stabbing into some corner of his fading soul.

In the final moment before losing consciousness, Chen Ji summoned his last thread of strength to open his eyes. Within his blurred vision, he could only make out Chen Nian's face—that tear-streaked face. He wished to say 'don't cry', wished to say 'brother succeeded', but his lips merely quivered faintly, ultimately unable to utter a single word. The altar's collapse echoed distantly in his ears, and that indifferent eye waited patiently...
